sens_en: to twist, to wring, to screw, stubborn
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche, 扌, la main ; à droite, 宁, le calme. 宁 se lit níng, comme 拧 : il donne le son, la main donne le sens. La main tord un linge jusqu'au calme de la dernière goutte.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left, 扌, the hand; on the right, 宁, calm. 宁 is read níng, like 拧: it gives the sound, the hand gives the meaning. The hand wrings a cloth until the calm of the last drop.
